research_role: test one simple implementation-announcement cash-dividend capture engine economically distinct from Industry Diffusion and price-volume selection

economic_hypothesis.mechanism: an implementation announcement of an imminent cash dividend may identify shareholder-distribution quality and create a bounded dividend-capture/attention window through the ex-date
economic_hypothesis.independence: the event is a cash-only corporate action and the ledger includes the exact cash credit; it does not use Industry Diffusion, Low-MAX, market state, support, candle, or Champion membership
economic_hypothesis.data_boundary: QD-010 is PIT-B current-history evidence; known_at is the conservative next calendar day after the date-only implementation announcement, and no strict PIT-A or historical-absence claim is made

frozen_strategy.event: QD-010 distribution with source_terms_complete == true, share_multiplier == 1, and cash_per_share_gross > 0
frozen_strategy.signal_time: first market-session completed close on or after known_at and strictly before effective_date, using the exact Cycle-015 causal eligibility row
frozen_strategy.selection: every eligible cash-dividend event stock on that signal date; duplicate same-symbol same-date notices collapse to one position; no dividend amount, yield, return, industry, or liquidity rank
frozen_strategy.entry: next legal market-session open after the signal close; blocked names are not backfilled
frozen_strategy.holding: 20 market sessions from entry to due open; the exact visible cash action is credited on effective date and future QD-010 risk events retain pre-effective handling
frozen_strategy.event_capital: minimum of available cash and one-twentieth pre-entry NAV per distinct signal date
frozen_strategy.weights: equal across executable event stocks on the date

sequential_protocol.full_replay: run exact 2018-01-02 through 2023-12-29 only when both gates pass; no rule change

required_diagnostics: event and signal-date counts, completed trades, entry coverage and capital-skipped events
cash credits conserved through the accepted visible-action ledger
total and annualized return, maximum drawdown, Sharpe, Calmar and calendar returns
severe-loss incidence, turnover, breadth, industry concentration and capacity
daily-return correlation and signal-date overlap with frozen Industry-Consensus Q1
prohibited: dividend-yield, cash amount, event-season, Top-N, holding-period, capital-divisor, or threshold search
same-signal-session fill, unresolved corporate-action coordinate, or historical-absence claim
stock return, momentum, Low-MAX, industry, support, candle, VWAP, panic, or post-shock recovery rank
validation outcome access before every generation requirement passes
combination with Strategy A before Strategy B independently passes
OOS, independent-confirmation, production, or live claim
